name: Layer tree and fixtures
description: LayerTree<Payload>, the one layer tree: LayerPayload, LayerNode (nesting, hide, lock, a follow link), LayerRow (the layers panel's flat rows from rows(expanded:)), ArrangeStep and TreeRefusal; move, arrange, group, ungroup, duplicate and the follow link are stubs for EK-12 and EK-13. Fakes/KernelFixtures.swift holds the shared fixtures: tree200 (200 nodes, seven roots, groups three deep, one hidden, one locked) and cards (the snapping packet's page in Desktop).
technology: Swift 6, Foundation (FoundationEssentials) and FlareCore, Linux and macOS
